nodes.label: iOS-Style Design System Integration
nodes.rationale: Enhanced MLBB theme with glassmorphism, refined shadows, iOS typography, and smooth animations for premium feel

nodes.label: MLBB Epic Gaming Fantasy Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Inspired by MLBB's heroic fantasy aesthetic with gold/blue color scheme and dynamic elements conveying competitive energy

nodes.label: Color Palette System
nodes.rationale: Combines iOS system colors with MLBB official colors (Gold, Blue, Dark Blue) for native-feeling UI with gaming identity

nodes.label: iOS-Style Typography System
nodes.rationale: Follows iOS conventions with refined letter spacing and line heights using Rajdhani/Orbitron for headings, Roboto/Montserrat for body, Teko/Chakra Petch for stats

nodes.label: iOS-Style Component Library
nodes.rationale: Includes iOSGlassCard, iOSElevatedCard, iOSPrimaryButton, iOSNavigationBar, iOSBottomSheet for premium feel

nodes.label: Glassmorphism Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Subtle glass backgrounds (72% opacity) with soft border highlights and layered depth for modern aesthetic

nodes.label: iOS-Inspired Motion Design
nodes.rationale: Animations follow iOS conventions with cubic bezier easing for smooth exits, balanced transitions, and bouncy interactions

nodes.label: 7-Tier Ranking Color System
nodes.rationale: Gradient colors from Bronze to Grandmaster for visual progression indication
